body: You Cannot Prepare for Where You Already Are There is nothing to overcome and nothing to prepare for—yon cannot prepare for where you already are. If you believe that some process in time will gradually release you from the illusion of samsara, then you are in avery secure position. But if you realize that the idea of time is the illusion of samsara then the whole business is finished up very quickly. As long as there is any invest¬ ment in the future, you are ahundred billion miles away from home. 6 1
